name: AlertDialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response. Built on @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog with animated overlay and content transitions. The action button uses the default buttonVariants style, and the cancel button uses the outline variant.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the alert dialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The default open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the open state changes.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogTrigger
subComponents.description: The button that opens the alert dialog.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto the child element instead of rendering a default button.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogPortal
subComponents.description: Portals the overlay and content into document.body.

props.name: container
props.description: The container element to portal into.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogOverlay
subComponents.description: A semi-transparent overlay that covers the viewport behind the dialog. Uses bg-black/80 with fade-in/fade-out animations.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogContent
subComponents.description: The centered modal content container. Renders inside a portal with an overlay. Max width is lg (32rem). Includes zoom and slide animations.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogHeader
subComponents.description: Layout wrapper for the title and description. Stacks vertically with centered text on mobile, left-aligned on sm+ breakpoints.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogFooter
subComponents.description: Layout wrapper for action and cancel buttons. Uses column-reverse on mobile, row with right-alignment on sm+ breakpoints.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogTitle
subComponents.description: The title of the alert dialog. Rendered as text-lg font-semibold.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogDescription
subComponents.description: A description providing more context. Rendered as text-sm text-muted-foreground.

subComponents.name: AlertDialogAction
subComponents.description: The confirm/action button. Styled with the default buttonVariants (primary background).

subComponents.name: AlertDialogCancel
subComponents.description: The cancel button that closes the dialog without taking action. Styled with buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline' }).

accessibility.role: Uses role='alertdialog' on the content element. The overlay and trigger are managed by Radix primitives.
accessibility.keyboard: Escape closes the dialog (returning focus to the trigger). Tab and Shift+Tab cycle focus within the dialog. Focus is trapped inside the dialog while open.
accessibility.aria: aria-labelledby is automatically set to the AlertDialogTitle id. aria-describedby is automatically set to the AlertDialogDescription id.
accessibility.notes: Unlike Dialog, AlertDialog does not close on overlay click. The user must explicitly choose an action or cancel. This follows the WAI-ARIA AlertDialog Pattern.
